translations.literal: All those in position bowed twice and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: All in position bowed twice and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 赴別殿賀皇帝，亦如賀皇太后之儀，惟不致詞，不宣答。

translations.literal: They proceeded to a separate hall to congratulate the emperor, also following the protocol for congratulating the empress dowager, except that they did not present formal words and no reply was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They proceeded to another hall to congratulate the emperor by the same protocol as for the empress dowager, except without formal speeches or a proclaimed reply.

sentences.zh: 冊皇太子儀

translations.literal: Ceremony for Conferring the Title of Crown Prince
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Conferring the Title of Crown Prince

sentences.zh: 大定八年正月，冊皇太子，禮官擬奏，皇太子乘輿至翔龍門，東宮官導從，不乘馬。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year of Dading, the crown prince was invested; the ritual officers drafted a memorial; the crown prince would ride in a palanquin to the Xianglong Gate, with Eastern Palace officials as guides and escorts, not riding horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Dading 8, the crown prince was invested. Ritual officers drafted the protocol: the crown prince would ride in a palanquin to the Xianglong Gate, escorted by Eastern Palace officials on foot rather than on horseback.

sentences.zh: 冊皇太子前三日，遣使同日奏告天地宗廟。

translations.literal: Three days before conferring the title of crown prince, envoys were dispatched on the same day to announce to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: Three days before the investiture, envoys were dispatched the same day to report to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 冊前一日，宣徽院帥儀鸞司，設御座于大安殿當中，南向。

translations.literal: On the day before the investiture, the Xuanhui Court led the Ceremonial Escort Office to set up the imperial seat in the center of the Da'an Hall, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the investiture, the Xuanhui Court directed the Ceremonial Escort Office to set the imperial seat in the center of the Da'an Hall, facing south.

sentences.zh: 設皇太子次於門外之東，西向。

translations.literal: They set up the crown prince's station outside the gate to the east, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's station was set outside the eastern gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 又設文武百僚應行事官，東宮官等次於門外之東、西廊。

translations.literal: They also set stations outside the gate in the eastern and western corridors for civil and military officials, ritual officers, Eastern Palace officials, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Stations were also set in the eastern and western corridors outside the gate for civil and military officials, ritual officers, and Eastern Palace officials.

sentences.zh: 又設冊寶幄次於殿后東廂，俱南向。

translations.literal: They also set up book-and-seal canopy pavilions in the eastern wing behind the hall, all facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Canopy pavilions for the book and seal were pitched in the eastern wing behind the hall, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 又設受冊位於殿庭橫階之南。

translations.literal: They also set the position for receiving the book south of the transverse steps in the hall courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: A station for receiving the investiture was also marked south of the transverse steps in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 工部官與監造冊寶官公服，自製造所導引冊寶床，由宣華門入，約宣徽院同進呈畢，赴幄次安置。

translations.literal: Officials of the Ministry of Works and the supervisors who had manufactured the book and seal, in official dress, guided the book-and-seal couches from the manufacturing office, entering by the Xuanhua Gate; they were to present them together with the Xuanhui Court and, when finished, proceed to the canopy pavilion to set them down.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Works officials and the book-and-seal manufacturing supervisors, in official dress, guided the presentation couches from the manufacturing office through the Xuanhua Gate, presented them jointly with the Xuanhui Court, and then set them down in the canopy pavilion.

sentences.zh: 大樂令帥其屬，展樂縣於庭。

translations.literal: The Director of Grand Music led his subordinates and deployed the music ensemble in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Grand Music led his staff and set up the music ensemble in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 其日，兵部帥其屬，設黃麾仗于大安殿門之內外。

translations.literal: On that day the Ministry of War led its subordinates and set up the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the gates of the Da'an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Ministry of War posted the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the Da'an Hall gates.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，文武百僚應行事官並朝服入次。

translations.literal: At dawn that day the civil and military hundred officials and ritual officers all entered their stations in court dress.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn civil and military officials and ritual officers entered their stations in full court dress.

sentences.zh: 東宮官各朝服，自東宮乘馬導從，至左翔龍門外下馬，入就次。

translations.literal: Eastern Palace officials each in court dress rode horses from the Eastern Palace as guides and escorts, dismounted outside the left Xianglong Gate, and entered to take their stations.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Palace officials in court dress rode from the Eastern Palace, dismounted outside the left Xianglong Gate, and entered their stations.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人分引百官入立班，東西相向。

translations.literal: The protocol secretaries in separate groups led the hundred officials in to stand in formation, facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol secretaries led the officials in to stand in east-west formation.

sentences.zh: 次引侍中、中書令、門下侍郎、中書侍郎及捧舁冊寶官，詣殿后幄次前立。

translations.literal: Next they led the Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and the officials who would lift and present the book and seal to stand before the canopy pavilion behind the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Next they led the Palace Attendant, Secretariat director, Chancellery and Secretariat vice directors, and book-and-seal bearers to stand before the canopy pavilion behind the hall.

sentences.zh: 少頃，奉冊寶出幄次，由大安殿東降，至庭中褥位，權置訖，奉引冊寶官立於其後。

translations.literal: After a short while the book and seal were brought out from the canopy pavilion, descended by the eastern side of the Da'an Hall to the cushioned position in the courtyard, temporarily set down, and the officials presenting the book and seal stood behind them.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the book and seal were brought from the canopy pavilion, carried down the eastern side of the Da'an Hall to the cushioned station in the courtyard, set down temporarily, with presentation officers behind them.

sentences.zh: 皇太子服遠遊冠、硃明衣出次，執圭，三師三少已下導從，立於門外。

translations.literal: The crown prince wore the distant-travel crown and vermilion-bright robe, came out from his station holding the jade tablet; the Three Preceptors, Three Mentors, and those below guided and followed, standing outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince wore the distant-travel crown and vermilion-bright robe, emerged holding the jade tablet, with the Three Preceptors, Three Mentors, and attendants escorting him to stand outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「中嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The inner court is made strict."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The inner court is now secured."

sentences.zh: 」符寶郎奉八寶由東西偏門分入，升置御座之左右。

translations.literal: The seal-and-treasure officers presented the eight treasures, entering separately by the eastern and western side gates, ascending and placing them to the left and right of the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Seal-and-treasure officers brought the eight imperial treasures in through the eastern and western side gates and set them on either side of the throne.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「外辦。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The outer preparations are complete."

sentences.zh: 」內侍承旨索扇，扇合，皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍以出，曲直華蓋侍衛如常儀，鳴鞭，宮縣樂作。

translations.literal: The inner attendants, receiving the command, requested the fans; the fans closed; the emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe and came forth, with curved and straight canopies and escort as in regular protocol; the whip was cracked and the palace bell-chime ensemble played.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants called for the fans, which closed; the emperor, wearing the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, emerged with the usual canopy escort; the whip cracked and the palace ensemble played.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出自東序，即御座，爐煙升，扇開簾卷，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor came forth from the eastern sequence, took the imperial seat, incense smoke rose, the fans opened, the curtain was rolled up, and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor emerged from the eastern side, took the throne, incense rose, the fans opened, the curtain was raised, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子入門，宮縣樂作，至位樂止。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonial announcements led the crown prince in through the gate; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; when he reached his position the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonial announcements led the crown prince through the gate to music from the palace ensemble, which ceased at his station.

sentences.zh: 師、少已下從入，立于皇太子位東南，西向。

translations.literal: The preceptors, mentors, and those below followed in, standing southeast of the crown prince's position, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Preceptors, mentors, and attendants followed in and stood southeast of the crown prince's station, facing west.

sentences.zh: 典儀贊：「皇太子再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies called out: "The crown prince bows twice."
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called: "The crown prince bows twice."

sentences.zh: 」搢圭，舞蹈，又再拜，奏：「聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: He tucked the jade tablet, performed the dance, again bowed twice, and memorialized: "May the sage person enjoy ten thousand blessings."
translations.idiomatic: He tucked the jade tablet, performed the dance, bowed twice again, and reported: "May Your Majesty enjoy ten thousand blessings."

sentences.zh: 」又再拜，引近東，西向立。

translations.literal: He again bowed twice, was led forward slightly to the east, and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed twice again, was led slightly forward to the east, and stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 師、少已下並奉引冊寶官等，各赴百官東班，樂作，至位樂止。

translations.literal: The preceptors, mentors, and those below together with the officials presenting the book and seal each went to the eastern formation of officials; music played; when they reached their positions the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Preceptors, mentors, book-and-seal presentation officers, and others moved to the officials' eastern formation to music, which stopped at their stations.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引百官俱橫班北向。

translations.literal: The protocol secretaries led all the hundred officials together in horizontal ranks facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol secretaries led all officials into north-facing horizontal ranks.

sentences.zh: 典儀贊：「拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies called out: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜，搢笏，舞蹈，又再拜，起居，又再拜，畢，百官各還東西班。

translations.literal: All officials in position bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance, again bowed twice, inquired after well-being, again bowed twice; when finished each official returned to the eastern and western formations.
translations.idiomatic: All officials bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance, bowed twice again, offered greetings, and bowed twice again; when finished they returned to east-west formation.

sentences.zh: 師、少已下並行事官各還立位。

translations.literal: The preceptors, mentors, and ritual officers each returned to stand in their positions.
translations.idiomatic: Preceptors, mentors, and ritual officers each returned to their stations.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子複受冊位，樂作，至位樂止。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonial announcements led the crown prince back to the position for receiving the book; music played; when he reached his position the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonial announcements led the crown prince back to the investiture station to music, which ceased when he arrived.

sentences.zh: 侍中承旨，稱：「有制。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant, receiving the command, announced: "There is an edict."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant, receiving the command, declared: "There is an edict."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子已下應在位官皆再拜，躬身，侍中宣制曰：「冊某王為皇太子。

translations.literal: The crown prince and all officials who should be in position below him all bowed twice, bowed the body; the Palace Attendant proclaimed the edict: "Invest Prince So-and-so as crown prince."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and all officials below him bowed twice and bowed low; the Palace Attendant proclaimed: "Prince [name] is invested as crown prince."

sentences.zh: 」又再拜。

translations.literal: They again bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: They bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人、太常博士引中書令詣讀冊位，中書侍郎引冊匣置於前，捧冊官西向跪捧，皇太子跪，讀畢，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: The protocol secretaries and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians led the Director of the Secretariat to the position for reading the book; the Vice Director of the Secretariat led the book case and set it before him; the book-presentation official knelt facing west and presented it; the crown prince knelt; when the reading was finished he prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol secretaries and academicians led the Secretariat director to the reading station; the vice director set the book case before him; the book-bearer knelt facing west and presented it; the crown prince knelt; when reading was finished he prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 皇太子再拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 中書令詣捧冊位，奉冊授皇太子，搢圭，跪受冊，以授右庶子，右庶子跪受，皇太子俯伏，興，右庶子以冊，興，置於床，中書令已下退複本班。

translations.literal: The Director of the Secretariat went to the position for presenting the book, reverently presented the book to the crown prince; the crown prince tucked the jade tablet, knelt and received the book, handed it to the Right Guardian of the Heir Apparent; the Right Guardian knelt and received it; the crown prince prostrated himself and rose; the Right Guardian raised the book, rose, and placed it on the couch; the Director of the Secretariat and those below withdrew and returned to their original formation.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat director presented the book to the crown prince, who tucked his tablet, knelt to receive it, and handed it to the Right Guardian of the Heir Apparent. The guardian knelt, received it, and set it on the couch as the director and others returned to formation.

sentences.zh: 次通事舍人、太常博士引侍中詣奉寶位，門下侍郎引寶盝立於其右，侍中奉寶授皇太子，搢圭，跪受，以授左庶子，左庶子跪受，皇太子俯伏，興，左庶子以寶興，置於床，侍中已下退複本班。

translations.literal: Next the protocol secretaries and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians led the Palace Attendant to the position for presenting the seal; the Vice Director of the Chancellery led the seal case and stood to his right; the Palace Attendant reverently presented the seal to the crown prince; the crown prince tucked the jade tablet, knelt and received it, handed it to the Left Guardian of the Heir Apparent; the Left Guardian knelt and received it; the crown prince prostrated himself and rose; the Left Guardian raised the seal, rose, and placed it on the couch; the Palace Attendant and those below withdrew and returned to their original formation.
translations.idiomatic: Next protocol secretaries led the Palace Attendant to present the seal; the Chancellery vice director stood with the seal case to his right. The crown prince received the seal and handed it to the Left Guardian of the Heir Apparent, who set it on the couch as the Palace Attendant and others returned to formation.

sentences.zh: 典儀贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies called out: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」畢，引皇太子退。

translations.literal: When finished, they led the crown prince to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, they led the crown prince to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 初行，樂作，左右庶子帥其屬，舁冊寶床匣以出，出門，樂止。

translations.literal: When he first set out, music played; the Left and Right Guardians of the Heir Apparent led their subordinates and lifted and carried the book-and-seal couches and cases out; when they exited the gate the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: As he set out, music played; the Left and Right Guardians led bearers carrying the book-and-seal couches and cases out through the gate, where the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The ceremony is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The rites are complete."

sentences.zh: 」內侍承旨索扇，扇合，簾降，鳴鞭，樂作，皇帝降座，入自西序還後閣，侍衛如來儀，扇開，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner attendants, receiving the command, requested the fans; the fans closed; the curtain was lowered; the whip was cracked; music played; the emperor descended from the seat and entered by the western sequence back to the rear pavilion; escort was as on the outward journey; the fans opened and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants called for the fans, which closed; the curtain lowered; the whip cracked; music played as the emperor left the throne and withdrew through the western side to the rear pavilion with the usual escort; the fans opened and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「解嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The strict watch is lifted."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The strict watch is lifted."

sentences.zh: 」所司承旨，放仗衛以次出。

translations.literal: The responsible offices, receiving the command, dismissed the guard formations to exit in order.
translations.idiomatic: On command, the responsible offices dismissed the guard formations to depart in order.

sentences.zh: 皇太子入次，改服公服，還東宮，導從如來儀。

translations.literal: The crown prince entered his station, changed into official dress, and returned to the Eastern Palace with escort as on the outward journey.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince entered his station, changed into official dress, and returned to the Eastern Palace with the same escort as before.

sentences.zh: 冊後二日，兵部設黃麾仗于仁政殿門之內外，陳設並如大安殿之儀。

translations.literal: Two days after the investiture, the Ministry of War set up the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the gates of the Renzheng Hall; the display was the same as at the Da'an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Two days after investiture, the Ministry of War posted the yellow-banner guard inside and outside the Renzheng Hall gates, with the same arrangements as at the Da'an Hall.

sentences.zh: 百官服朝服。

translations.literal: The hundred officials wore court dress.
translations.idiomatic: All officials wore court dress.

sentences.zh: 皇太子公服至次，改服遠遊冠、硃明衣。

translations.literal: The crown prince in official dress arrived at his station and changed into the distant-travel crown and vermilion-bright robe.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince arrived at his station in official dress and changed into the distant-travel crown and vermilion-bright robe.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引百官入至階下立班，東西相向。

translations.literal: The protocol secretaries led the hundred officials in to stand in formation below the steps, facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol secretaries led the officials to stand below the steps in east-west formation.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子執圭出次，立於門外。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonial announcements led the crown prince, holding the jade tablet, out from his station and to stand outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonial announcements led the crown prince out holding the jade tablet to stand outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「中嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The inner court is made strict."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The inner court is now secured."

sentences.zh: 」少頃，又奏：「外辦。

translations.literal: After a short while he again memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete."
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he reported again: "The outer preparations are complete."

sentences.zh: 」皇帝出自東序，即座，簾卷。

translations.literal: The emperor came forth from the eastern sequence, took his seat, and the curtain was rolled up.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor emerged from the eastern side, took the throne, and the curtain was raised.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引百官俱橫班北向，典儀贊：「拜。

translations.literal: The protocol secretaries led all the hundred officials together in horizontal ranks facing north; the master of ceremonies called out: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: Protocol secretaries led all officials into north-facing ranks; the master of ceremonies called: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜，搢笏，舞蹈，又再拜，起居，又再拜，訖，分班。

translations.literal: All officials in position bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance, again bowed twice, inquired after well-being, again bowed twice; when finished they divided into formations.
translations.idiomatic: All officials bowed twice, tucked their tablets, performed the dance, bowed twice again, offered greetings, bowed twice again, then divided into formation.

sentences.zh: 皇太子捧表入，至拜表位立，俟閣門使將至，單跪捧表，閣門使接表，皇太子俯伏，興，典儀贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince presented the memorial, entering to stand at the position for presenting the memorial; when the Palace Gate commissioner was about to arrive he knelt on one knee and presented the memorial; the Palace Gate commissioner received the memorial; the crown prince prostrated himself and rose; the master of ceremonies called out: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince entered with his memorial and stood at the presentation station; when the Palace Gate commissioner approached he knelt on one knee to present it; after the commissioner received it the crown prince prostrated himself and rose; the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」搢圭，舞蹈，又再拜。

translations.literal: He tucked the jade tablet, performed the dance, and again bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He tucked the jade tablet, performed the dance, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 俟讀表單，侍中承旨退稱：「有制。

translations.literal: When the reading of the memorial was finished, the Palace Attendant, receiving the command, withdrew and announced: "There is an edict."
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial had been read, the Palace Attendant withdrew and declared: "There is an edict."

sentences.zh: 」典儀贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies called out: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」興，躬身，侍中宣訖，典儀贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: They rose, bowed the body; when the Palace Attendant had finished proclaiming, the master of ceremonies called out: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: They rose and bowed low; when the Palace Attendant had finished proclaiming, the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」搢圭，舞蹈，又再拜。

translations.literal: He tucked the jade tablet, performed the dance, and again bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He tucked the jade tablet, performed the dance, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 引皇太子退。

translations.literal: They led the crown prince to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: They led the crown prince to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The ceremony is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The rites are complete."

sentences.zh: 」扇合，鳴鞭，入西序，還後閣，侍衛如來儀。

translations.literal: The fans closed; the whip was cracked; he entered by the western sequence and returned to the rear pavilion; escort was as on the outward journey.
translations.idiomatic: The fans closed; the whip cracked; the emperor withdrew through the western side to the rear pavilion with the usual escort.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏：「解嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized: "The strict watch is lifted."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported: "The strict watch is lifted."

sentences.zh: 」放仗，百官以次出。

translations.literal: The guard formations were dismissed; the hundred officials exited in order.
translations.idiomatic: The guard was dismissed; officials departed in order.

sentences.zh: 後二日，百官奉表稱賀，如常儀。

translations.literal: Two days later the hundred officials presented memorials offering congratulations, as in regular protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later officials submitted congratulatory memorials following regular protocol.

sentences.zh: 正旦生日皇太子受賀儀

translations.literal: Ceremony for the Crown Prince to Receive Congratulations on New Year's Day and Birthday
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for the Crown Prince to Receive Congratulations on New Year's Day and Birthday

sentences.zh: 大定二年，世宗命有司議親王百官及妃主命婦見皇太子禮。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading, Emperor Shizong ordered the relevant offices to deliberate the protocol for imperial princes, the hundred officials, and consorts, princesses, and titled women to audience with the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2, Emperor Shizong ordered the relevant offices to determine the protocol by which imperial princes, officials, consorts, princesses, and titled women would attend upon the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 有司按唐、宋舊儀，擬親王宗室賀皇太子，依冊畢受賀禮。

translations.literal: The relevant offices, following the old protocols of Tang and Song, drafted that imperial princes and imperial clansmen should congratulate the crown prince, following the protocol for receiving congratulations after the investiture was complete.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices, following Tang and Song precedent, proposed that imperial princes and clansmen congratulate the crown prince using the post-investiture congratulations protocol.

sentences.zh: 然唐禮元正複有降階見伯叔、答群官再拜之文，又無妃主命婦見太子之禮。

translations.literal: However, in Tang ritual on New Year's Day there were also provisions for descending the steps to meet uncles and for the crown prince to return bows to the assembled officials, and there was no protocol for consorts, princesses, and titled women to audience with the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Tang ritual also required the crown prince on New Year's Day to descend the steps to greet uncles and return bows to officials, but included no protocol for consorts, princesses, or titled women to attend upon him.

sentences.zh: 稽古令文，應致恭之官相見，或貴賤殊隔，或長幼親戚，任從私禮。

translations.literal: Examining ancient regulations, when officials who should show respect met one another, whether separated by noble and humble rank or related as elder and younger or kin, they might follow private ceremonial protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient regulations held that when officials bound to show respect met, whether divided by rank or linked as elders, juniors, or kin, private ceremonial forms might apply.

sentences.zh: 自今若在東宮候皇太子，便服，則當從私禮接見。

translations.literal: From now on, if one awaits the crown prince in the Eastern Palace in ordinary dress, one should receive him according to private ceremonial protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, when awaiting the crown prince in the Eastern Palace in ordinary dress, one should receive him according to private ceremonial forms.

sentences.zh: 若三師以下，遇皇太子誕日，在御前，則候皇太子先進酒畢，百官望皇太子再拜，班首跪進酒，又再拜。

translations.literal: If among the Three Preceptors and those below, on the crown prince's birthday, when before the emperor, they should await the crown prince to advance wine first; when finished the hundred officials gaze toward the crown prince and bow twice; the head of the formation kneels and advances wine, and again bows twice.
translations.idiomatic: On the crown prince's birthday, when the Three Preceptors and those below were before the emperor, they awaited the crown prince to offer wine first; then all officials bowed twice toward him; the lead official knelt to offer wine and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 若賜酒，即當殿跪飲畢，又再拜。

translations.literal: If wine was bestowed, they knelt in the hall, drank when finished, and again bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: If wine was bestowed, they knelt in the hall, drank, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 以為定制，命班行之。

translations.literal: This was established as the fixed protocol and ordered to be observed in formation.
translations.idiomatic: This was established as fixed protocol and ordered observed throughout the court.

sentences.zh: 十二月晦，皇太子奏狀曰：「按禮文，親王並一品宗室皆北面拜伏，臣但答揖而已。

translations.literal: On the last day of the twelfth month the crown prince submitted a memorial stating: "According to the ritual texts, imperial princes and first-rank imperial clansmen all face north, bow, and prostrate themselves, while I need only return a bow with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the twelfth month the crown prince submitted a memorial: "By ritual text, imperial princes and first-rank clansmen all face north and prostrate themselves, while I need only return a bow with joined hands.

sentences.zh: 雖曰尊宗子，而在長幼惇敘之間，誠所未安。

translations.literal: Although this is said to honor the lineage head, between the obligations of elder and younger in fostering kinship, I truly am not at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Although this is said to honor the lineage head, I am uneasy with the breach of elder-junior kinship obligations.

sentences.zh: 當時遽蒙頒降，未獲謙讓。

translations.literal: At that time I hastily received the promulgation and did not obtain opportunity for modest refusal.
translations.idiomatic: I had hastily received the promulgation and had no chance to decline modestly.

sentences.zh: 明日元正，有司將舉此禮，伏望聖慈許臣答拜，庶敦親親友愛之義。

translations.literal: Tomorrow on New Year's Day the relevant offices will perform this ceremony; I bow before the sage compassion to permit me to return bows, that the meaning of cherishing kin and loving kin may be honored."
translations.idiomatic: Tomorrow on New Year's Day the offices will perform this rite; I beg imperial compassion to let me return bows, so that the duty of cherishing kin may be honored."

sentences.zh: 」上從其請，命尚書省頒下所司。

translations.literal: The emperor granted his request and ordered the Department of State Affairs to promulgate it to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted his request and ordered the Department of State Affairs to promulgate it to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 若皇太子生日，則公服，左上露臺欄子外。

translations.literal: If it was the crown prince's birthday, they wore official dress and stood outside the railing of the upper left terrace platform.
translations.idiomatic: On the crown prince's birthday they wore official dress and stood outside the upper left terrace railing.

sentences.zh: 先再拜，二閣使齊揖入欄子內，拜跪，祝畢，就拜，興，復位，再拜，又再拜，棲台進酒，退跪。

translations.literal: They awaited the drinking to be finished, received the cup, returned to position, turned the terrace over to the officiants, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: When drinking was finished they received the cup, returned to position, handed the terrace to the officiants, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 候飲畢，接盞，復位，轉臺與執事者，再拜。

translations.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner advanced with wine; the emperor personally bestowed wine; they received the cup, withdrew slightly and knelt to drink; when finished the Xuanhui Commissioner received the cup; they returned to position and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanhui Commissioner brought wine; the emperor personally bestowed it; they received the cup, withdrew slightly, knelt and drank; when finished the commissioner received the cup; they returned to position and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使以酒進，皇帝親賜酒，接盞稍退跪飲，畢，宣徽使接盞，復位再拜。

translations.literal: Again they bowed with joined hands and entered inside the railing, knelt and tucked their tablets, received the bestowed objects; when finished they withdrew their tablets, rose, returned to position, bowed twice, withdrew to change clothes, entered the hall slightly to the east, and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Again they bowed with joined hands, entered the railing, knelt and tucked their tablets, received the bestowed objects, rose, returned to position, bowed twice, withdrew to change clothes, entered the hall slightly east, and stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 複揖入欄子內，跪搢笏，受賜物畢，出笏，興，復位，再拜，退更衣，入殿稍東，西向立。

translations.literal: Imperial consorts and the like advanced wine to encourage the birthday celebration; the crown prince knelt; the imperial consorts also knelt; when the drinking was finished each again bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial consorts advanced birthday wine; the crown prince knelt; the consorts also knelt; when drinking was finished each bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 皇妃等進勸生日酒，皇太子跪，皇妃等亦跪，飲畢，各再拜。

translations.literal: When the assembled officials offered congratulations, on that day at dawn all wore official dress and gathered outside the gate; the Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent memorialized: "Request the inner court be made strict."
translations.idiomatic: For officials' congratulations, at dawn that day all gathered outside the gate in official dress; the Junior Guardian memorialized: "Request that the inner court be secured."

sentences.zh: 群官致賀，則其日質明，皆公服集於門外，少詹事奏：「請內嚴。

translations.literal: When the assembled officials offered congratulations, on that day at dawn all wore official dress and gathered outside the gate; the Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent memorialized: "Request the inner court be made strict."
translations.idiomatic: For officials' congratulations, at dawn that day all gathered outside the gate in official dress; the Junior Guardian memorialized: "Request that the inner court be secured."

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「外備。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete."
translations.idiomatic: He reported again: "The outer preparations are complete."

sentences.zh: 」典儀引升座，文武宮臣入，就庭下重行北向立，典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonial announcements led him to ascend to the seat; civil and military palace officials entered and stood below the courtyard in double rows facing north; the master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonial announcements led him to the throne; palace civil and military officials entered and stood in double rows below the courtyard facing north; the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜，班首稍前跪奏：「元正首祚。

translations.literal: All officials in position bowed twice; the head of the formation knelt slightly forward and memorialized: "The first fortune of New Year's Day."
translations.idiomatic: All officials bowed twice; the lead official knelt forward and reported: "The first fortune of New Year's Day."

sentences.zh: 」生日則雲：「慶誕令辰，伏惟皇太子殿下福壽千秋。

translations.literal: On a birthday it was said: "Celebrating the auspicious day of birth; we bow before the crown prince's exalted person: may blessings and longevity be a thousand autumns."
translations.idiomatic: On a birthday they said: "Celebrating this auspicious birth; we bow before the crown prince: may blessings and longevity endure a thousand autumns."

sentences.zh: 」賀畢復位，典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: When the congratulations were finished they returned to position; the master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: When congratulations were finished they returned to position; the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」宮臣皆再拜，坐受，分東西序立。

translations.literal: Next they led the Eastern Palace Three Preceptors onto the hall platform and the Three Mentors outside the hall pillars, facing north in ascending order to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Eastern Palace Three Preceptors were led onto the hall platform and the Three Mentors outside the hall pillars, facing north in ascending order to the east.

sentences.zh: 次引東宮三師於殿上，三少於殿柱外，北向東上立。

translations.literal: The crown prince went to the south-facing cushioned position; the master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince went to the south-facing cushioned station; the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 皇太子詣南向褥位，典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The preceptors and mentors all bowed twice; the head of the formation as before offered congratulations and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: Preceptors and mentors bowed twice; the lead official offered congratulations as before and returned to position.

sentences.zh: 」師、少皆再拜，班首同前稱賀，復位。

translations.literal: The officiants poured one cup of wine; the head of the formation reverently advanced it; music played; when the drinking was finished the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Officiants poured one cup of wine; the lead official presented it; music played; when drinking was finished the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 執事者酌酒一卮，班首奉進，樂作，飲訖，樂止。

translations.literal: When the return toast to the preceptors and mentors was finished, each returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: When the return toast to preceptors and mentors was finished, each returned to position.

sentences.zh: 回勸師、少畢，各復位。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies called for the preceptors and mentors to bow twice; the crown prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called for preceptors and mentors to bow twice; the crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 典儀贊師，少再拜，皇太子答拜。

translations.literal: The preceptors and mentors went out; the crown prince took his seat.
translations.idiomatic: Preceptors and mentors withdrew; the crown prince took his seat.

sentences.zh: 師、少出，皇太子就坐。

translations.literal: Next they led the imperial princes inside the railing, first-rank imperial clansmen outside the railing, and the remaining clansmen in ordered formation below the courtyard; they bowed, offered congratulations, and advanced wine as in the protocol above.
translations.idiomatic: Next imperial princes were led inside the railing, first-rank clansmen outside it, and remaining clansmen in formation below the courtyard; they bowed, congratulated, and advanced wine as above.

sentences.zh: 次引親王入欄子內，一品宗室於欄子外，余宗室序班庭下，拜致賀、進酒如上儀。

translations.literal: Next they led the imperial princes inside the railing, first-rank imperial clansmen outside the railing, and the remaining clansmen in ordered formation below the courtyard; they bowed, offered congratulations, and advanced wine as in the protocol above.
translations.idiomatic: Next imperial princes were led inside the railing, first-rank clansmen outside it, and remaining clansmen in formation below the courtyard; they bowed, congratulated, and advanced wine as above.

sentences.zh: 皇太子答拜畢，就坐。

translations.literal: When the crown prince had finished returning bows, he took his seat.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince had finished returning bows, he took his seat.

sentences.zh: 複引隨朝三師三公宰執於殿上，三品以上職事官於露階上，四品以下於庭下，北向，每等重行以東為上，立。

translations.literal: Again they led the attending Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, and chief ministers onto the hall platform, third-rank and above functional officials onto the terrace platform, fourth-rank and below in the courtyard below, all facing north; each grade in double rows with the east as superior, standing.
translations.idiomatic: Again attending Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, and chief ministers were led onto the hall platform; third-rank and above onto the terrace; fourth-rank and below into the courtyard below, each grade in double rows facing north with the east as the place of honor.

sentences.zh: 皇太子詣褥位。

translations.literal: The crown prince went to the cushioned position.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince went to the cushioned station.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」上下皆再拜，畢，班首少前致賀，復位，執事者酌酒一卮，班首奉進，樂作，飲畢，樂止。

translations.literal: Those above and below all bowed twice; when finished the head of the formation advanced slightly and offered congratulations, returned to position; the officiants poured one cup of wine; the head of the formation reverently advanced it; music played; when the drinking was finished the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: All above and below bowed twice; the lead official advanced slightly to congratulate and returned; officiants poured wine; the lead official presented it to music that ceased when drinking was finished.

sentences.zh: 如有進獻如常儀。

translations.literal: If there were presentations they followed regular protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Presentations, if any, followed regular protocol.

sentences.zh: 回勸三師三公，餘殿上群官則令執事者以盤行酒，飲畢，典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: For the return toast to the Three Preceptors and Three Excellencies, the remaining officials on the hall platform were given wine by the officiants on trays; when the drinking was finished the master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: For the return toast to the Three Preceptors and Three Excellencies, remaining hall officials received wine on trays from officiants; when drinking was finished the master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」上下皆再拜，乃答拜，引群官以次出。

translations.literal: Those above and below all bowed twice; then they returned bows and led the assembled officials out in order.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice, then returned bows, and led the officials out in order.

sentences.zh: 少詹事跪奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: The Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent knelt and memorialized: "The ceremony is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Junior Guardian knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."

sentences.zh: 」自是歲賀為定制。

translations.literal: From then on annual congratulations were fixed as the established protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Annual congratulations were thereafter fixed as established protocol.

sentences.zh: 皇太子與百官相見儀

translations.literal: Ceremony for the Crown Prince to Audience with the Hundred Officials
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for the Crown Prince to Audience with the Hundred Officials

sentences.zh: 三師三公欄子內北向躬揖，班首稍前問侯，皇太子離位稍前，正南立，答揖。

translations.literal: The Three Preceptors and Three Excellencies inside the railing bowed the body facing north with joined hands; the head of the formation advanced slightly to inquire after well-being; the crown prince left his seat slightly forward, stood due south, and returned the bow with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Preceptors and Three Excellencies inside the railing bowed facing north with joined hands; the lead official advanced slightly to offer greetings; the crown prince left his seat slightly, stood due south, and returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 宰執及一品職事官扣欄子北向躬揖，答揖如前。

translations.literal: Chief ministers and first-rank functional officials bowed the body at the railing facing north with joined hands; the crown prince returned the bow with joined hands as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers and first-rank functional officials bowed at the railing facing north with joined hands; the crown prince returned the bow as before.

sentences.zh: 二品職事官欄子外向南躬揖，皇太子起揖。

translations.literal: Second-rank functional officials outside the railing bowed the body facing south with joined hands; the crown prince rose and returned the bow with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: Second-rank functional officials outside the railing bowed facing south with joined hands; the crown prince rose and returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 三品職事官露階稍南躬揖，皇太子坐揖。

translations.literal: Third-rank functional officials on the terrace slightly south bowed the body with joined hands; the crown prince, seated, returned the bow with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank functional officials on the terrace slightly to the south bowed with joined hands; the seated crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 四品以下職事官庭下躬揖，跪問候，皇太子坐受。

translations.literal: Fourth-rank and below functional officials in the courtyard bowed the body with joined hands, knelt to inquire after well-being; the crown prince, seated, received them.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth-rank and below bowed in the courtyard with joined hands and knelt to offer greetings; the seated crown prince received them.

sentences.zh: 太子太師、太傅、太保與隨朝三師同。

translations.literal: The Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent were the same as the attending Three Preceptors.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent followed the same forms as the attending Three Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 東宮三少與隨朝二品同。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace Three Mentors were the same as the attending second-rank officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace Three Mentors followed the same forms as attending second-rank officials.

sentences.zh: 詹事已下，並在庭下麵北，每品重行以東為上，再拜，稍前問候，又再拜，皇太子坐受。

translations.literal: The Guardian of the Heir Apparent and those below all stood in the courtyard facing north; each grade in double rows with the east as superior; they bowed twice, advanced slightly to inquire after well-being, again bowed twice; the crown prince, seated, received them.
translations.idiomatic: The Guardian of the Heir Apparent and those below stood in the courtyard facing north by grade in double rows with the east as superior; they bowed twice, advanced slightly to greet, bowed twice again; the seated crown prince received them.

sentences.zh: 大定二年所定也。

translations.literal: In the seventh year a fixed protocol was established: when the crown prince attended court he was permitted to meet imperial princes and chief ministers; other officials and imperial clansmen all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year it was fixed that when the crown prince attended court he might meet imperial princes and chief ministers, while other officials and clansmen withdrew.

sentences.zh: 七年，定制，皇太子赴朝，許與親王宰執相見，餘官宗室並回避。

translations.literal: Later he was also permitted to meet the deputy commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs, the Censor-in-Chief, the Director of the Imperial Clan Court, and the Eastern Palace Three Preceptors.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was also permitted to meet the Bureau of Military Affairs deputies, the Censor-in-Chief, the Director of the Imperial Clan Court, and the Eastern Palace Three Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 後亦許與樞密使副、御史大夫、判宗正、東宮三師相見。

translations.literal: In the ninth year a fixed protocol was established: whenever the crown prince went out, a cushioned position was set three li outside the capital gate; the Three Excellencies, chief ministers, and those below in official dress stood in double rows; the crown prince in ordinary dress; the Three Excellencies, chief ministers, and those below bowed the body; the head of the formation offered words: "May the Eastern Palace enjoy ten thousand blessings."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year it was fixed that whenever the crown prince went out, a cushioned station was set three li outside the capital gate; the Three Excellencies, chief ministers, and those below in official dress stood in double rows; the crown prince in ordinary dress; they bowed the body; the lead official said: "May the Eastern Palace enjoy ten thousand blessings."

sentences.zh: 九年，定制，凡皇太子出，于都門三裏外設褥位，三公宰執以下公服重行立，皇太子便服，三公宰執以下鞠躬，班首致辭雲：「青宮萬福。

translations.literal: In the ninth year a fixed protocol was established: whenever the crown prince went out, a cushioned position was set three li outside the capital gate; the Three Excellencies, chief ministers, and those below in official dress stood in double rows; the crown prince in ordinary dress; the Three Excellencies, chief ministers, and those below bowed the body; the head of the formation offered words: "May the Eastern Palace enjoy ten thousand blessings."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year it was fixed that whenever the crown prince went out, a cushioned station was set three li outside the capital gate; the Three Excellencies, chief ministers, and those below in official dress stood in double rows while the crown prince wore ordinary dress; they bowed the body and the lead official said: "May the Eastern Palace enjoy ten thousand blessings."

sentences.zh: 」再拜，皇太子答拜，退。

translations.literal: They bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 迎、送皆同。

translations.literal: Welcoming and sending off were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming and sending off followed the same protocol.
